mcq.question: What is the advantage of `create_autospec(Notifier, instance=True)` over a plain `Mock()`?

options.D: It fails when code calls a method or signature that the real `Notifier` doesn't have

mcq.explanation: A plain `Mock` accepts any call, so tests keep passing after the real interface changes. Autospec catches that drift.

mcq.question: Why does `LendingService` take `today` as a callable?

options.C: Tests can freeze and move time (due dates, fines) without waiting or patching the system clock

mcq.explanation: An injected clock makes every fine calculation deterministic.
